Estimated from the photo, the tray holds:
- A toasted muffin with cheese and egg (about 300 kcal).
- Two slices of white toast (about 160 kcal).
- A fried or poached egg (about 90 kcal).
- Two butter portions (about 70 kcal).
- Milky tea (about 40 kcal).

The served total is about 660 kcal.

The photo was taken before eating, so I can't see what will be left over. I assumed about 10% is left, roughly 60 kcal, which leaves about 600 kcal eaten.

For the macros of the amount eaten, I scaled the full-tray estimates down by the same 10%. The full tray comes to roughly 25 g protein, 65 g carbohydrate and 32 g fat. The eaten amounts below are rounded from that.
